description: Small font sizes (<14px) difficult to read on projected display
reproduction_steps: Observe text sizes in demo content
observed_evidence: Found 4 text elements <14px: P "New in v1.4.0: Daily nutrition + fitness" (12px); BUTTON "Retry" (12px); P "Desktop-width product review" (12px). At projector viewing distance, <14px is hard to read.
suggested_fix: Ensure all demo-path text ≥14px; prefer 16px+ for body, 20px+ for headings on projector flow.

description: CTA buttons <40px height are small click targets on projector
observed_evidence: Found buttons <40px high: "Retry" (34px). Small targets difficult to click with mouse from projector distance.
suggested_fix: Use ≥40px button heights for demo CTAs; add generous padding.

description: /app/log: Key actions positioned at right edge, unreachable for left-thumb user
observed_evidence: Found 3 interactive elements (center >300px) in bottom half: "" at x=318px; "" at x=358px. Require hand shift or right hand for left-thumb user.
suggested_fix: Place primary actions within 0-200px horizontal range for left-thumb reach; mirror/duplicate critical nav/actions on both sides.

description: Log form has excessive instructional language ("Please enter", "Click here", "Type your search")
reproduction_steps: Read form labels and helper text
observed_evidence: Found 7 instructional word instances. Over-explanation clutters the form.
suggested_fix: Simplify: use placeholder text instead of labels when obvious (search input = "Banana, yogurt, ..."). Reduce "please" and imperatives.
